snippet: Nam Ji-sung and Park Ui-sung advanced to the men's doubles final in tennis at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Thursday, moving within a win of South Korea's first tennis title in 12 years. Nam and Park defeated Ho Chenjui and Hsu Yu-hsiou of Chinese Taipei 2-1 (7-6 (7-3), 2-6, 11-9) in the semifinals at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center in Nagoya, central Japan. In the final scheduled for Friday, the South Korean team will face either Jiang Fumin and Zhang Tianhui of China or Yusuke Kusuhara and Shunsuke Nakagawa of Japan. Those two teams were to meet in the semifinals later Thursday. South Korea has not produced an Asiad tennis champion since Chung Hyeon and Lim Yong-kyu won the men's doubles gold medal in 2014. South Korea had set out to take home four gold medals in tennis, but all singles players were knocked out well before medal contention in their tournaments, while the women's doubles and the mixed doubles teams were also sent packing early.

title: 美铁全新Airo列车正式投入营运
snippet: 【大纪元2026年10月01日讯】（记者紫樱综合报导）9月30日，美铁（Amtrak）正式在Cascades路线启用全新Airo列车组，这是该型列车首次在美国地区载客营运，太平洋西北地区成为首批搭乘新车的乘客。 目前共有两组Airo列车投入服务，每日运行四班，往返于加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华（Vancouver）、美国西雅图（Seattle）、波特兰（Portland）及俄勒冈州尤金（Eugene）之间。美铁表示，预计在2027年初之前，将有更多Airo列车陆续加入，最终全面取代现有的车队。美铁已为该路线订购八组Airo列车组，另附两台机车及一辆备用驾驶车厢。 新车在舒适度、科技配置及无障碍设计方面均有显着提升。每组列车设有超过300个座位，配备全景车窗、可调式头枕座椅、免费Wi-Fi、电源插座及USB充电端口。车厢内设有数位乘客资讯显示屏、无障碍座位、自动踏板及改良的导引标示系统。列车共配备六间厕所，均采用触控式控制设计。车上咖啡厅的菜单则以太平洋西北地区的在地食材为灵感，提供特色餐饮。 首批时刻表方面，北行516次列车于早上8时30分从西雅图出发前往温哥华，南行508次列车则于下午4时30分从尤金出发前往西雅图。 美铁代理总裁拜尔·赫尔曼（Byl Herrmann）在声明中表示：“Airo车队的到来，是太平洋西北地区铁路运输令人振奋的时刻。” 华盛顿州交通部长朱莉·梅瑞狄斯（Julie Meredith）则称新车为“游戏改变者”，并指出太平洋西北地区是全国第一个启用Airo列车的区域。 责任编辑：舜华

title: U.S. Poverty Rate Hits Record Low. Welfare Reform Can Help It Go Lower
snippet: The U.S. poverty rate in 2025 dropped to its lowest level in history, according to the latest U.S. Census Bureau report. Poverty is now at 10.5%, down slightly from last year. Child poverty also hit its lowest level ever, dropping to 13.4%. Top of Form The Census Bureau also reported that inflation-adjusted median household income grew by 2.6% and hit an all-time high. This is good news. But the poverty rate is even lower than what the official poverty measure shows. This is because a substantial amount of earnings among low-income households goes unaccounted for. The Census Bureau measures poverty by adding up household income and measuring it against a poverty threshold that varies by household size. About 40% of earnings among the lowest income thresholds, though, is unreported. Instead of measuring poverty by using household income, some scholars have examined poverty using household spending.
